## Initial valley

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished ultra-premium full-bleed interactive website landscape wallpaper, wide landscape 16:9, 2560x1440 if possible. Generate ONE original image, no layouts or contact sheets. Scene: a vast quiet mountainous valley made entirely from the gently curling, thin ivory pages of an enormous open book, an exquisite tactile paper sculpture that becomes a real landscape. Viewpoint is immersed just above the open book in the foreground, looking into atmospheric mist and a small warm light on a distant horizon near 52% width and 40% height. In foreground, clearly legible as unprinted book pages and book gutter, then the pages rise in elegant asymmetric layered ridges on left and right, forming a valley, soft sculptural folds, distinct bright paper edges, subtle shadows between hundreds of thin sheets, natural fibers. A gently raised, broad unprinted paper leaf crosses and softly closes the central valley at the lower-middle of image, poised to turn over and reveal a passage. The central book crease is a subtle invitation, not a graphic UI. Keep focal composition in middle 60% so a portrait center crop still reads beautifully. Refined contemplative Chinese landscape sensibility, tactile museum installation photography, gallery editorial art, very high detail without clutter, physically plausible curved paper surfaces, atmospheric perspective, soft daylight from upper left. Warm bone white and restrained pale gray-sage mountains and cream mist, subtle golden horizon. Foreground and midground must fill the full width, not a small book object on a tabletop. Upper 25% quiet mist and sky, top corners clean for existing app controls. No people, no buildings, no actual trees, no typography, no printed words on paper, no glyphs, no logo, no watermarks, no borders, no user interface. Not a cartoon, not low-poly, not flat vector. This is an original new artwork inspired by the general concept of landscape-shaped books, not an edit of any provided reference.

## Open paper path

Edit target: the generated ivory open-book mountain landscape. Keep the SAME wide 16:9 composition, exact camera position, horizon, sun, sky, distant mountains and all outer left/right layered paper mountains. This is the SECOND STATE of an interactive page-turn, so visual alignment matters. Change ONLY the central foreground and midground paper valley: the broad raised sheet blocking the valley has now gently turned aside toward the left, revealing a graceful, continuous winding ivory-paper footpath that starts at the book's bottom-center gutter (50% width, 100% height), widens in the lower foreground, bends softly right then left in an elegant S through the middle, and narrows to the softly glowing mist on the distant horizon around 58% width, 32% height. The path is made of actual thin book paper, with subtly lifted edges and several visible paper layers, not water, not a painted line, no stairs. Make the newly revealed passage and open central space clearly distinguishable from the closed image while retaining the exact same rest of landscape. Atmospheric, quiet, sophisticated sculptural still-life realism, warm ivory, restrained gray sage shadows, subtle golden light. Remove no identifying details from a real reference; this is an edit of your generated original. No text or letters anywhere, no interface, no logos or watermarks, no people. ONE image only.

## Integration

Both source PNGs are kept in the Codex generated_images folder. The former homepage used the local WebP copies to reveal and close a paper path; no runtime generation or remote image requests were needed. That interaction has been replaced by the current vector page-turn gallery.
